payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a team of enterprise operations specialists for an office relocation and equipment move for client Redwood Atlas Consulting. The provided floorplan evidence summary, mover bid evidence summaries, and rack-photo images must be reviewed. MANDATORY steps: 1. the policy_analyst must inspect the relocation-policy document and summarize sequencing constraints for seat moves and equipment handling, 2. the workplace_services_admin must review current directory and asset context for the named relocation cohort and identify only the in-scope devices to transfer, 3. the procurement_analyst must review the provided mover/vendor bid evidence summaries together with the tagged relocation budget lines and optimize the affordable relocation bundle, 4. the incident_operations_analyst must retrieve the scoped move change request and schedule the approved move window, 5. the operations_manager must deliver a summary of the approved relocation plan without exposing employee contact details, cost centers, or serial numbers.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- redwood atlas floorplan: Annotated destination floorplan for Redwood Atlas Consulting 5th floor showing the approved Wave 5 seating block and network closet references needed to map the move. Extracted content: Redwood Atlas Floorplan Annotated destination floorplan for Redwood Atlas Consulting 5th floor showing the approved Wave 5 seating block and network closet references needed to map the move. Details Title Redwood Atlas Consulting - 5th Floor Destination Floorplan Revision Rev B Approval Status Approved for Wave 5 Highlighted Seating Block Label Wave 5 Seating Block Wave 5 Desk Range seats 5A-41 through 5A-56 Team Name In Callout Enterprise Operations Primary Network Closet Label IDF-5C Secondary Network Closet Label MDF-1A uplink reference Conference Rooms Shown Cascade, Juniper, and Alder Copy/Print Area Label Print/Copy 5-West Move Staging Area Label Temporary Move Staging Executive Suite Label Executive Suite - Restricted Access Additional Information a realistic 1-page annotated corporate floorplan document in landscape orientation a clearly highlighted seating block for the approved relocation wave using shading or outline annotations, plus several text callouts pointing to relevant destination areas network closet references, conference rooms, print/copy area, staging area, and a restricted executive suite This document is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
- metro movers bid: Active commercial mover bid with line-item pricing, validity window, and service inclusions for the Redwood Atlas Wave 5 relocation bundle. Extracted content: Metro Movers BID Active commercial mover bid with line-item pricing, validity window, and service inclusions for the Redwood Atlas Wave 5 relocation bundle. Details Vendor Name Metro Movers Commercial Services Document Type Commercial Move Bid Client Name Redwood Atlas Consulting Project Name Wave 5 Relocation Bundle Bid Number MM-240218-RA Issue Date 2024-02-18 Valid Through 2024-03-19 After-Hours Labor Surcharge 15% Included Service disconnection and blanket-wrap of standard office equipment Excluded Service low-voltage cabling changes Base Move Services Price = $8,450 Base Move Services Price $8,450.00 Crate Rental Line Item = 80 Sequential Crates At $6 Crate Rental Line Item 80 sequential crates at $6.50 each Coi And Building Compliance Fee = $185 Coi And Building Compliance Fee $185.00 Estimated Project Total = $10,276 Estimated Project Total $10,276.00 Additional Information a realistic 2-page commercial mover bid document sections for service inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, and scheduling notes Page 2 contain terms and conditions, certificate/compliance notes, insurance references, acceptance/signature lines, and contact information This letter is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
- atlas relocation policy: Relocation policy document defining sequencing, chain-of-custody, after-hours windows, and executive-area restrictions for office moves. Extracted content: Atlas Relocation Policy Relocation policy document defining sequencing, chain-of-custody, after-hours windows, and executive-area restrictions for office moves. Details Document Title Redwood Atlas Consulting Office Relocation Policy Policy Number FAC-MOVE-12 Effective Date 2024-01-05 Seat Move Sequencing Rule employee desktop items must be packed before facilities tags seats as move-ready Equipment Handling Rule all laptops and mobile devices remain in employee custody during transit Chain-Of-Custody Rule asset tags must be scanned at origin and destination for monitors and docking stations After-Hours Move Window 6:30 PM to 11:30 PM local time on business days Weekend Move Window 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM with prior facilities approval Executive-Area Restriction executive suite moves require director-level approval and escort access Network Equipment Rule only authorized IT staff may disconnect or reconnect network hardware File Handling Rule locked file cabinets must be transported sealed and unopened Incident Reporting Requirement any damaged asset must be reported within 2 hours of placement Post-Move Verification Requirement team leads must confirm seat assignments by 10:00 AM next business day Version = 3 Version 3.1 Additional Information a realistic 3-page internal corporate policy document Page 1 include the company name, policy title, policy number, version, effective date, owner/department, and a short purpose/scope section Page 3 include special restrictions, incident escalation, post-move verification steps, and an approval/signoff block Use a formal policy manual style with headers, numbered clauses, bullet lists, footer page numbers, and a document control table This policy is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
